articles.summary: New autonomous vacuum expands Tennant's robotics portfolio with a practical, easy-to-use solution for everyday commercial cleaning Tennant Company (NYSE: TNC), a world leader in designing, manufacturing, and marketing solutions to reinvent how the world cleans, today announced the launch of the P1 VAC , the company's first autonomous robotic vacuum. Designed to make robotic cleaning approachable and practical for everyday commercial environments, the P1 VAC combines autonomous vacuuming and dust mopping with a side brush that sweeps debris from walls and edges into the machine's cleaning path. The compact platform helps facilities maintain consistent cleaning standards, increase productivity, and make better use of existing labor resources. Tennant Company P1 VAC Autonomous Vacuum The introduction of the P1 VAC expands Tennant's growing autonomous cleaning portfolio and underscores the company's continued investment in robotics innovation through Tennant Company Robotics. articles.summary: Tennant Company (NYSE: TNC) today announced that the company will report its third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Monday, November 2, 2026, with a conference call to follow at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time/ 9:00 a.m. Central Time on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The conference call will be webcast and can be accessed on the company’s website at investors.tennantco.com . A replay of the webcast and accompanying slides will be available on the company’s website. Company Profile Founded in 1870, Tennant Company (TNC), headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, is a world leader in the design, manufacture and marketing of solutions that help create a cleaner, safer and healthier world. Its products include equipment for maintaining surfaces in industrial, commercial and outdoor environments; detergent-free and other sustainable cleaning technologies; and cleaning tools and supplies.
